name: premium-commercial-keynote-visual-system

industrial-swiss-line.assetPromptIntent: photorealistic robotic production line or precision manufacturing scene, right-side equipment protagonist, pale steel editorial field, no readable text, no logos, no watermark

brand-system-board.assetPromptIntent: premium brand identity workbench with packaging, swatches, material samples and UI mockups, no readable text, no logos, no watermark, no abstract geometric-only art

kinetic-field-launch.assetPromptIntent: dynamic launch-stage environment with real spatial depth, fabric or light installation, motion energy, clean left text-safe zone, no readable text, no logos, no watermark

cold-luxury-product.assetPromptIntent: premium cold-luxury product render or hardware still life on silver-grey material stage, large inspectable product on right, no readable text, no logos, no watermark

architecture-blueprint-studio.assetPromptIntent: dark enterprise architecture blueprint studio with glass table, luminous platform diagrams and server-room depth, clean left text-safe zone, no readable text, no logos, no watermark, avoid wireframe placeholder bars, centered divider rules, long horizontal guide lines, and repeated UI stripe rows

fontPolicy.rule: CJK body text favors PingFang SC; Chinese decks localize non-essential visible labels and use PingFang SC for them, while preserved acronyms/Latin source terms use Avenir Next; numbers use DIN Alternate, and editorial serif is limited to beauty/culture statement roles.

principles: Route by proof object first: metric, process, architecture, case image, value chain, risk, manifesto.
Use photos as evidence or showcase unless the image has a clean safe zone for text.
Vary rhythm at contact-sheet scale: stage cover, editorial content, proof object, system map, gallery, close.

strategy-map.proofObject: flow from drivers to actions to outcomes

culture-manifesto.proofObject: one strong statement plus supporting values

risk-matrix.proofObject: prioritized matrix, not a plain table

claimSpine.rule: Every slide needs one claim, one proof object, and only the supporting text needed to read the proof.

semanticColorTokens.darkText: Primary readable text on dark pages.
semanticColorTokens.darkMuted: Secondary text and quiet metadata on dark pages.
semanticColorTokens.darkLine: Borders, dividers, and diagram lines on dark pages.
semanticColorTokens.panelAlt: Alternative panel fill for light pages.
semanticColorTokens.photoOverlay: Overlay color used to control photo contrast.
semanticColorTokens.captionOnImage: Caption text over darkened image bands.

semanticColorRoles.rule: Colors are semantic roles, not decoration. A slide may use 2-3 roles; each role must have a visual carrier such as a caption bar, metric strip, side field, risk band, evidence frame, or action rail. In Chinese decks, these carriers use Chinese labels unless the term is a required acronym or source title.

brand.meaning: Brand, industry identity, navigation, page system, and structural emphasis.

evidence.meaning: Proof, real-image captions, source notes, screenshots, site photos, and case evidence.

risk.meaning: Problems, gaps, constraints, compliance, authorization, and risk priority.

action.meaning: Implementation path, next step, decision gate, operating action, and rollout movement.

data.meaning: Metric, value signal, comparison, scorecard, and chart emphasis.

neutral.meaning: Readable background, body text, quiet separators, and low-emphasis labels.

roleFit.background: Require wide aspect ratio and a clean text safe zone; busy product, factory, table, or screenshot images are rejected as backgrounds.
roleFit.showcase: Keep the subject visible in a dedicated image area; do not overlay paragraphs.
roleFit.evidence: Use framed panels and captions; screenshots and field photos remain inspectable.
roleFit.gallery: Use consistent crop ratios and captions; image quality beats image count.

generatedAssetPolicy.rule: Generated bitmap assets may fill missing atmosphere, abstract motifs, concept scenes, and generic category visuals; they must never replace factual proof.

themeIntents.industry-opening: Deck opener or first proof of industry relevance.
themeIntents.risk-warning: Risk, constraint, authorization, governance, or compliance page.
themeIntents.case-evidence: Real image, screenshot, case, product, site, or certificate evidence page.
themeIntents.system-architecture: Architecture, topology, data flow, operating model, or capability map.
themeIntents.value-signal: Metric, scorecard, comparison, value, or outcome page.
themeIntents.operating-path: Timeline, rollout, process, flywheel, or closed-loop page.
themeIntents.company-proof: Company profile, capability proof, qualification, or business card page.
themeIntents.closing-anchor: Back-cover, contact, next-step, or final decision anchor.

backgroundTones.dark-stage: High-contrast dark anchor page for opener, chapter, quote, or closing rhythm.
backgroundTones.tinted-paper: Industry-tinted near-white page. Never pure white for finished commercial decks.
backgroundTones.accent-wash: Light page with stronger primary-color budget: top rule, side field, watermark, and accent rail.

themeCoverage.low: Only allowed for appendices or deliberately plain tables.
themeCoverage.medium: Default body-page budget. Requires at least top rule, folio/page number, watermark or rail.
themeCoverage.high: Cover, chapter, company profile, evidence hero, and closing budget. Requires a visible dark/accent anchor.

compositionGrammar.rule: Structured content must first become a compositionPlan before drawing. Renderers consume the plan; they do not invent visual strategy ad hoc.

principles: Reference decks are not color templates. They define rhythm, evidence hierarchy, and disciplined theme coverage.
Theme color must have visible carriers on body slides: dark information block, caption bar, metric strip, vertical axis, page number, or anchored rule. Thin lines alone are insufficient.
Slide numbers and item numbers are anchored components. Page numbers stay fixed at the same top-right coordinate; object numbers attach to a row, node, or cell instead of floating freely.
Most light pages use a low-saturation paper tone plus one strong dark or accent block. This produces premium calm without becoming blank.
Every image-led page treats images as evidence with caption bars or source notes; images are not decorative fillers.
Every three to four slides include a rhythm change, usually a dark statement/navigation page or a high-coverage evidence page.

portableRules.darkAnchorUse: preferred for governance, company profile, proof board, chapter, and closing pages

general-operations.label: 数字化运营
general-operations.insight: 让业务闭环建立在统一数据之上
general-operations.coreBody: 以中心能力雷达串联关键模块，表达平台不是功能堆叠，而是围绕业务闭环形成能力场。

manufacturing-operations.label: 制造运营
manufacturing-operations.insight: 让设备状态成为现场协同的起点
manufacturing-operations.coreBody: 以设备状态雷达串联资产、报警、工单、保养、备件和生产指标，形成现场运维闭环。

industrial-park.label: 园区运营
industrial-park.insight: 让园区服务围绕空间与企业流动
industrial-park.coreBody: 以空间、企业、服务、资产与运营指标为核心节点，形成园区管理与服务协同网络。

healthcare-operations.label: 医疗运营
healthcare-operations.insight: 让服务质量、资源调度和患者体验进入同一套运营视图
healthcare-operations.coreBody: 以患者旅程、医护资源、服务响应、风险治理和质量指标为核心，形成可信、合规、可追踪的医疗运营闭环。

finance-investment.label: 金融投资
finance-investment.insight: 让投资判断建立在统一口径、风险约束和资本效率之上
finance-investment.coreBody: 以市场假设、核心指标、组合风险、资本配置和复盘机制为核心，形成面向管理层的决策闭环。

brand-retail.label: 品牌零售
brand-retail.insight: 以产品组合、空间体验与会员运营构建可复盘增长闭环
brand-retail.coreBody: 以产品、门店、内容、会员和经营指标为核心，形成从品牌记忆到复购经营的增长闭环。

beauty-consumer.label: 美妆品牌世界
beauty-consumer.insight: 用产品质地、包装细节、场景记忆和会员经营共同证明品牌价值
beauty-consumer.coreBody: 以品牌世界观、单品证据、消费者场景、渠道会员和可持续证明为核心，形成高配图、可复盘的消费品牌叙事。

energy-utility.label: 能源运营
energy-utility.insight: 让电站运行从事后巡检走向实时调度
energy-utility.coreBody: 以设备状态、负荷曲线、储能策略、告警工单与收益指标为核心，形成电站运行闭环。

boardroom-ink.intent: Default premium business palette for technology, operations, and client proposals.

energy-ops-clean.intent: Clean EV charging and energy-operations palette: white operating surfaces, thin cool borders, dispatch blue, telemetry cyan, service green, and amber action signals.

japan-editorial-navy.intent: Japanese-style business clarity: navy structure, off-white background, restrained accent.

graphite-ivory.intent: Premium but quiet palette for professional services, real estate, culture, and luxury-adjacent decks.

sage-operations.intent: Calm operations palette for healthcare, ESG, education, and service quality decks.

signal-charcoal.intent: High-contrast product, AI, security, and launch decks; use sparingly.

factory-steel-amber.intent: Manufacturing-specific palette: light steel paper, visible steel-blue brand structure, safety-orange action marks, and green evidence signals.

industrial-graphite.intent: Low-saturation industrial palette for manufacturing company introductions, field proof, and operational evidence decks.

finance-slate.intent: Conservative executive reporting, finance, investment, and governance decks.

warm-white-redline.intent: Editorial corporate palette for brand, retail, culture, and leadership narratives.

consumer-commerce-teal-coral.intent: Cross-border commerce and consumer retail palette: cool teal evidence surfaces, coral action marks, clean white panels, and restrained executive contrast.

beauty-warm-premium.intent: Luxury beauty and consumer-brand palette: warm ivory surfaces, deep lacquer anchors, product-proof red, teal evidence, and restrained bronze warmth.

backgroundModes.solid: Use palette-driven pure or near-solid backgrounds. Best for data-heavy, management, legal, finance, governance, strategy, and internal reports.
backgroundModes.photo: Use a high-quality full-bleed or split photo when the image is evidence or creates the scene. Always darken or wash the image for text contrast.
backgroundModes.hybrid: Use a mostly solid slide with one disciplined photo panel, band, or case image. Best for product, case, site, manufacturing, energy, real estate, retail, healthcare, and education.
backgroundModes.generated: Use generated bitmap assets only when no real source asset exists and the slide needs an abstract scene, texture, product metaphor, or high-quality visual backdrop.
backgroundModes.case-gallery: Use multiple real images when the deck is case-led, portfolio-led, product-led, property-led, venue-led, or before/after-led.

imageRoles.background: Atmospheric photo with safe text zones. Never use a busy product/equipment/screenshot image as background.
imageRoles.showcase: Product, equipment, production line, venue, or object that must be clearly visible. Text lives in a separate solid area.
imageRoles.evidence: Site photo, screenshot, case proof, or detail image. Use a bordered panel and short caption.
imageRoles.comparison: Before/after or old/new image pair. Split into comparison zones instead of using a combined image as a background.
imageRoles.gallery: Multiple case/product/place images with consistent crop ratios and captions.

default.assetPolicy: Prefer solid backgrounds unless a user-provided or clearly sourced image directly proves the slide claim.

energy-utility.assetPolicy: Use real station/storage imagery selectively; internal pages should stay mostly structural unless discussing sites, assets, cases, or field context.

manufacturing-operations.assetPolicy: Use factory/equipment photos for field evidence; use solid layouts for process, OEE, KPI, and architecture pages.

industrial-park.assetPolicy: Use spatial/park images for place context and case pages; keep management and risk pages clean.

government-public-sector.assetPolicy: Prefer solid, sourced, policy-first layouts. Use real public-site imagery only when a user-provided or cleared source directly proves the claim.

healthcare-operations.assetPolicy: Use calm, human-safe imagery only when relevant; avoid decorative medical stock photos.

finance-investment.assetPolicy: Prefer solid backgrounds, charts, evidence tables, and conservative contrast. Photos are exceptional.

brand-retail.assetPolicy: Use product, venue, packaging, and campaign visuals as proof; keep text areas disciplined and uncluttered.

beauty-consumer.assetPolicy: Beauty decks are image-led. If user-owned product/scene assets are missing, ask whether to provide assets, skip images, or generate clearly synthetic category visuals that never impersonate a real brand or product proof.

general-operations.name: executive-operations-system
general-operations.principle: Use restrained management-report structure: claims, operating evidence, and decision actions stay clearly separated.
general-operations.primaryColorLogic: Navy anchors structure; blue accents mark decisions, page numbers, and key comparisons.

manufacturing-operations.name: factory-evidence-system
manufacturing-operations.principle: Make physical proof, process precision, and delivery traceability visible; avoid generic consulting card grids.
manufacturing-operations.primaryColorLogic: Steel blue carries the deck identity, page system, and structure; safety orange marks actions, gates, and risk; green marks evidence.

healthcare-operations.name: clinical-quality-system
healthcare-operations.principle: Use calm clinical structure: patient journey, handoff responsibility, quality signals, and governance must stay legible.
healthcare-operations.primaryColorLogic: Sage marks service flow and quality; olive marks throughput; dark green carries governance or quote anchors.

brand-retail.name: retail-editorial-system
brand-retail.principle: Lead with product, space, and customer memory; images are edited like a lookbook and metrics explain behavior.
brand-retail.primaryColorLogic: Redline marks brand memory and editorial sectioning; teal is a secondary proof signal for member or channel data.

beauty-consumer.name: luxury-beauty-editorial-system
beauty-consumer.principle: Lead with inspectable product and texture imagery, then make every metric, caption, and governance note explain what the visual proves.
beauty-consumer.primaryColorLogic: Deep lacquer carries brand authority, red marks product proof and editorial structure, teal marks evidence or member data, bronze marks business or sustainability warmth.

finance-investment.name: capital-governance-system
finance-investment.principle: Use conservative disclosure logic: capital bridge, assumptions, risk, and decision gates must remain auditable.
finance-investment.primaryColorLogic: Slate carries governance; blue marks base case; teal marks upside or liquidity; amber marks risk or sensitivity.

energy-utility.name: site-dispatch-system
energy-utility.principle: Tie site evidence to dispatch logic: assets, alerts, load, SOC, and operating actions form the visual grammar.
energy-utility.primaryColorLogic: Blue marks dispatch state, cyan marks asset telemetry, amber marks alerts or commercial action.

saas-technology.name: product-platform-system
saas-technology.principle: Make product workflows and adoption proof explicit; avoid generic feature-card grids without system relationships.
saas-technology.primaryColorLogic: Electric blue marks platform actions; cyan marks integration or automation; violet marks governance or AI layers.

motifs.breathing_circle: Low-contrast circular field for dark and light canvases. Use it as atmosphere, never as a busy diagram.
motifs.energy_lens: Energy-specific field made from quiet circles and minimal state labels. Do not render decorative load curves without source-traced chart data.
motifs.energy_photo_backdrop: Real BESS site photo, dark-graded for cover and closing pages. Use for energy-utility decks when the deck needs a stronger first impression than vector-only atmosphere.
motifs.energy_photo_detail: A tighter BESS detail crop for inner-page editorial splits, problem pages, and value pages. It should support the narrative instead of acting as decoration.
motifs.energy_photo_band: A panoramic BESS band for chapter navigation and rollout pages. Use as a quiet grounding layer near the bottom or edge of the canvas.
motifs.energy_motion_backdrop: Five-second slow-push MP4 derived from the energy photo. Optional only; use when the output environment supports embedded video cleanly.
motifs.operating_loop: Closed oval loop for capability maps. Prefer one clean closed form over mixed ellipses plus arrows.

rules: Every visual line must explain structure, flow, or data; decorative diagonal stripe clusters are forbidden.
Chinese titles and localized labels use PingFang SC or the platform fallback; preserved Latin terms use Avenir Next; numbers use DIN Alternate.
Premium pages should feel spatial and calm first, detailed second.
Use one accent color per slide unless a chart or risk matrix genuinely needs a second signal color.
Prefer near-white or near-black backgrounds over pure white or pure black for long decks.
Images must be evidence, place, product, people, or case context. Do not add images just because a pure-color slide feels empty.
